meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交或创建PR前需要强制验证测试通过
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce verification before committing or creating PRs

howto.what: 每当要声称工作完成、修复或通过前，它必须先运行完整验证命令、查看输出、核对证据，才能给出结论。没有实际验证，就不能宣称成功。
howto.when: 当它即将声称工作完成、修复或测试通过，或提交代码、创建 PR 前触发；对“应该没问题”等暗示成功的话也生效。

say.text: 先运行测试命令，确认零失败后再声称通过。
say.note: 它会先跑测试，再给出有证据的结论。

say.text: 创建 PR 前，先运行构建命令，并确认退出码为 0。
say.note: 确保构建通过，你才能创建 PR。

say.text: 你说 bug 已修复，请先验证原始症状是否消失。
say.note: 它会独立验证，而不是直接相信。

howto.what_en: Before claiming any work is complete, fixed, or passing, Claude must run the corresponding verification command in full, read the output, and confirm it matches the claim. No evidence, no success claims.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude is about to claim completion, fixes, or passing tests, or before committing, creating PRs, or expressing satisfaction. Also applies to paraphrases implying success.

say_en.text: Run the tests and only say they pass with 0 failures.
say_en.note: Claude runs tests before claiming success.

say_en.text: Before creating the PR, run the build and confirm exit code 0.
If you say the bug is fixed, verify the original symptom is gone.
say_en.note: Claude will verify independently instead of trusting the claim.
